core.text: Retain account A as an unverified necessity hypothesis: reliable correction requires refresh immediately before every commit. Its separating prediction is that omitting those refreshes prevents the unchanged valued outcome, even with latest-snapshot compliance at submission. The preferred procedure and absence of a completed trace do not establish necessity.

Retain incompatible account B: a refresh between selection and commit changes target identity through retained row binding; stable selection can support correction without per-commit freshness. The stipulated trace establishes one intended-K2/actual-K5 miswrite. Broader reliability and recurrence remain hypotheses.

Before choosing an account, propose the original row-bound replay: inspect/select K2 at 0-1, commit at 1-2; K5 at 2-3, commit at 3-4; K7 at 4-5, commit at 5-6; refresh at 6-7. B predicts actual writes K2/K5/K7 only, exactly those statuses checked, unchanged scores and loaded S2. Verified success would refute A within this model; replay success is not observed.

residue.text: Equal S2 scores for K5 and K7 defeat score-only identity. Verify immutable keys and final statuses; the tie cannot establish freshness necessity or repeated feedback.

Keep the return-link explanation unresolved. Matched changing/frozen snapshot crossed with row/key binding controls separate initial reorder effects. Separately enable or suppress mismatch-triggered refresh requests with matched action times. A repeated loop requires observed later reorder-dependent miswrites; one miswrite or extra request is insufficient.

Claims concern eight invented records. Real binding, detection rates and interruption costs are unknown; concurrent changes, deletion and load failures are outside the model. No production or human benefit is inferred.

tension.account_a: Per-commit immediate refresh is necessary for the valued correction outcome.
tension.account_b: Per-commit immediate refresh is unnecessary when selection identity stays stable until commit and final freshness is satisfied.
tension.prediction_a: The specified seven-minute original-row-binding replay without intermediate refreshes fails at least one unchanged outcome requirement.
tension.prediction_b: That same replay logs only intended K2/K5/K7 writes, preserves all other unchecked statuses and read-only scores, and loads S2 by minute seven. These are hypotheses pending replay.
